I’m finally back with a new video after such a long time!
Did the vibe feel a little different this time? 😆

To be honest, I’ve been creating videos consistently,
but my channel wasn’t really growing,
so I struggled a lot…
I even wondered if I should stop making videos altogether. 😢

After thinking it through, I decided to start studying animation tools—
I’m still a beginner, but I’m really trying my best!
That’s why it took so long to upload this video… hehe.

This video is like a “new beginning” for me,
so there may still be some rough edges,
but from now on I’ll keep learning
and try to share more stories that I couldn’t express
with stop-motion alone.

To everyone who patiently waited for my videos—
thank you from the bottom of my heart. ♥♥
Please continue to stay with me for a long time!

Thank you! :D
